site.title: Ryan Kuo | Aspiring Full-Stack Developer
site.description: Hello! I'm Ryan Kuo, a 10th grader at Round Rock High School in Austin, Texas, and an aspiring front end and back end developer.

hero.name: Ryan Kuo
hero.tagline: An aspiring versatile front end and back end developer.

about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: Hello there! My name is Ryan Kuo, an aspiring computer science major hoping to make a change in this world. I'm a 10th grader at Round Rock High School and a versatile software developer with experience in frontend and backend.
Whether developing a sleek frontend or a robust backend, I focus on clean code, maintainability, and performance.

passions.heading: Passion Projects & Extracurriculars
passions.intro: I'm just getting started, and I'm planning to build many more projects as I keep learning.

cs.title: Java Teaching on Instagram
cs.subtitle: @rkthecoder1
cs.description: I run an Instagram account that creates software development related content to a growing community of learners. I mostly teach important Java concepts, but may throw in a meme or two to keep things alive. In the future, I am planning to create my own free Java and Python course, turn it into a website, and share it with others to help other aspiring software developers out.

cs.title: Multiversal Robotics
cs.subtitle: FTC Team 32610 · Round Rock High School
cs.description: I'm a member of Round Rock High School's FIRST Tech Challenge robotics team, Multiversal. We are currently participating in the 2026-2027 FTC BIOBUZZ challenge, and I have contributed lots towards the robots code already. I am always looking forward to the next meeting and am always excited to help my team.

cs.title: USACO
cs.subtitle: USA Computing Olympiad
cs.description: This year, I have decided to tackle USACO, an incredibly prestigious and difficult competition. Although I sometimes may struggle, I am rapidly improving. I hope to achieve silver, or maybe even gold, this year.

cs.title: CSUIL Club
cs.subtitle: Round Rock High School
cs.description: I am an active member at my schools CSUIL club. Although I struggled last year, I have drastically improved my Java programming skills over the summer, and am hoping to become a CSUIL officer next year.

other.title: Piano
other.subtitle: Texas Music Teachers Association (TMTA)
other.description: I have been playing piano for over 10 years. I have competed in lots and lots of competitions over these 10 years, most notably the ADMTA solo contest, Blinn college competition, the Scholarship Contest, and most importantly, TMTA state competition, or Texas Music Teachers Association State Competition. TMTA is the most prestigious and competitive out of all of these competitions. I have won first or second in most of these competitions, and have received 2 honorable mentions and 1 third place at the TMTA final state competition.
highlights: TMTA State competition, Honorable Mention (2024, 2025), 3rd place (2026)
Blinn college competition, Honorable Mention (2024), Second place (2023)

other.title: FASCA Austin
other.description: I'm a hardworking member of FASCA Austin. I am currently a Group Leader for my Pu Tai IEEP Online English Teaching group, a TA for a first grade Chinese class, and also teach Taiwanese culture to students. I'm hoping to create a website in the future to contribute to our organization/association.
